Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evaluation plan (next steps)

Monica / Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. We pulled the MAP into our procurement board and have a few items the engineering team wants clarified before we lock dates for the evaluation run. Main asks:

- Confirm streaming support for our long-lived websocket flows (we need token refresh guidance).
- Clarify auth model: will we use per-service API keys or OIDC with short-lived tokens?
- SDK timeline: can you deliver the Node SDK integration sample by next Tuesday so our devs can try local end-to-end?

I attached the MAP draft that our legal asked us to review.

Jordan
Integracom (Platform Lead)

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evaluation plan (next steps)

Jordan —

Appreciate the list. Aligning internal owners below and proposing a short weekly checkpoint cadence (Tuesdays, 30m UTC-7) until evaluation completes. High-level answers up front:

- Streaming: supported; long-lived streams OK. We recommend token refresh every 45 minutes using our refresh endpoint. Sean will provide the exact curl examples.
- Auth: default path for production pilots is OIDC (short-lived tokens + RBAC). We can support per-service API keys during evaluation if you prefer simpler setup.
- SDK sample: Marissa will ship a Node SDK integration example (websocket + kv cache) by Tue 26 May.

Attached: updated MAP with milestones and owners + an integration checklist (spreadsheet to follow).

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Marissa: Node SDK sample by 2026-05-26.
2) Sean: token refresh examples + streaming best-practices doc by 2026-05-24.
3) Karthik: security questionnaire answers (SOC2 snippets) by 2026-05-25.
4) Integracom: confirm evaluation window (2 weeks) and provide sample dataset by 2026-05-27.

If that works I’ll lock the Tuesday cadence — first checkpoint Tue 2026-05-26 09:00 PT.

Thanks,
Monica
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint prep — Node SDK sample check-in

Quick update from eng on the Node sample and streaming proof-of-concept:

- Node SDK sample: repo link (internal) ready; packaging + README in progress. I’ll share a public gist for your devs by EOD Tue 26 May.
- Streaming: validated continuous websocket for 3 hours with token refresh flow; example uses refresh token endpoint that exchanges a short-lived grant. Edge case: reconnect logic needs to surface last-offset resume which we’ll include.
- Tool calling: basic tool-calling example (external API webhook + function sig) included in the sample. Complex tool orchestration (multi-tool recovery) will be a follow-up.

Open question for Integracom: do you want function call responses proxied through your backend (preferred for auditability) or handled directly by the client SDK?

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer

> Thanks — that sounds good. We'll review the sample. One ask: could you add a short section in the README about logging/tracing so our SREs can tie tokens back to user sessions?

> Jordan

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@integracom.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@integracom.com>
Date: Mon, 26 May 2026 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — token refresh + streaming guidance

Jordan / team —

Sharing the streaming & auth snippets I mentioned. Highlights:
- Refresh endpoint: POST https://auth.redwood.ai/v1/refresh-token (body: grant_id) -> 200 with {access_token, expires_in}.
- We recommend access_token lifetime = 1h for production; for evaluation you can use 4h windows if you prefer fewer refresh calls.
- Example reconnect pattern included (exponential backoff, jitter).

Also attaching a short logging checklist: include request_id, client_session_id, and model_request_id in logs to correlate.

Sean
Principal Infra Engineer
attachment: streaming-auth-snippets.txt (txt)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 27 May 2026 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Weekly checkpoint notes + owner RACI (Integracom MAP)

Jordan — thanks for making time this morning. Notes from today’s 30m and owners below. Posting here so the MAP stays in the thread for procurement.

Meeting summary:
- Confirmed evaluation window: 2026-06-02 -> 2026-06-15 (2 weeks). Goal: validate throughput at 50 qps and verify streaming/session resume behavior with 100 concurrent clients.
- Node SDK public gist shared by Marissa (link posted in Slack).
- Integracom will supply a 10k-row anonymized dataset for quality eval by 2026-05-29.
- Procurement: Integracom legal wants a short addendum on data retention and audit logs; Monica to coordinate with Legal.

Action items (owner — due):
- Marissa Cole — Publish Node SDK sample + README with logging/tracing section — 2026-05-26 (DONE).
- Sean Gallagher — Post streaming/auth snippets + reconnect example — 2026-05-26 (DONE).
- Karthik Iyer — Provide SOC2 extract, data handling notes, and KMS integration doc — 2026-05-25 (IN PROGRESS).
- Integracom (Jordan) — Deliver anonymized eval dataset (10k rows) — 2026-05-29.
- Monica Patel — Draft procurement addendum on data retention + audit approach and share with Integracom legal — 2026-05-28.
- Monica Patel / Sales Ops — Prepare proposal with evaluation pricing for 2-week pilot and target close by 2026-06-10 — 2026-05-31.

Risks / blockers:
- Data transfer SLA: need to confirm acceptable SFTP vs. presigned S3 method. Karthik noted any method requiring HSM-backed encryption will take extra time.
- Tool calling orchestration: sample works for single external webhook; complex chained calls will be scoped for post-eval.

Next checkpoint: Tue 2026-06-02 09:00 PT (first day of evaluation) — short standup for smoke test results.

If any corrections to owners/dates, reply-all and I’ll update the MAP document.

Regards,
Monica
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
